title: Best AI reviewer makers from PDF and PowerPoint
summary: For PDF or PowerPoint review, pick a tool that preserves what the diagram, caption and lecturer's note say together.
body_markdown:
Choose a PDF or PowerPoint reviewer by what the question depends on. Knowt documents presentation and PDF summaries on Ultra. NotebookLM is a useful source companion for an assigned reading. A slide with arrows, speaker notes or a correction in the margin deserves a closer check before you practise from either output.


Educato publishes this comparison. We describe the limits of our own file-based reviewer alongside the other options.


## What should I look for in an AI reviewer maker from PDF?


Look for a question whose answer you can trace to the page, including its caption. A clean paragraph often survives conversion more easily than a two-column reading. On your phone, open a page that has a sidebar. Copy a few lines into a blank note. If the sidebar interrupts a sentence, a reviewer might also join passages that belong apart. Select the relevant passage yourself and give it a descriptive heading.


Begin with an allowed course file and an answer you already understand. Ask for the page or section behind the answer, then actually open that passage. A reference can point to the right chapter while the question attributes the opposite conclusion to its author. Pay particular attention to “except,” “sometimes” and words that specify which group a result describes.

## How do I choose an AI reviewer maker from PPT?


Choose one that keeps slide order and preserves the relationship between labels and figures in your actual deck. Knowt's Student Ultra page describes summaries of presentations, PDFs and recordings. The plan description establishes which materials it advertises. It cannot establish whether a particular animation, hidden slide or set of notes in your lecturer's file will appear in your reviewer.[Knowt documentation, checked 2026-11-27](https://knowt.com/plans?tab=Student+Ultra) .


Educato is best suited to practice from permitted class materials, including slide decks. **Limits.** An uploaded slide may contain only the image the lecturer pointed at. If the explanation happened aloud, write your own account of that explanation and check it with the lecturer before treating it as an answer key. A file reader cannot reconstruct a classroom discussion from a blank arrow.


## What happens when the PDF and the slides look identical?


They can still communicate different things. Imagine a geography slide showing a town map with a shaded area, a dashed line and a key. On the presentation, clicking reveals that the shading means the survey area and the line means a route walked by the survey team. In a PDF export, the map survives but the last line of the key falls below the page. This is an original example you can recreate on paper.


Ask which homes were eligible to be counted and which streets the team actually visited. The shaded boundary answers the first question. The route helps answer the second. A card that says all homes in the shaded area were visited has silently turned eligibility into an observation. Cross out the answer and restore the missing legend before generating alternatives. Even a perfectly transcribed street name would not fix that error.


If your teacher supplies both files, compare that one page side by side. A readable PDF with its legend can be a better source than a native slide full of overlapping labels. Conversely, a slide with essential notes can be better than a flattened PDF. Decide separately for each figure. You can write your own short caption in a study note and leave the original untouched for checking.


## Searching for “AI quiz maker from PDF free”? What can you actually practise?


Use a short passage, keep a handwritten key and see how much of the study session the free account lets you complete. Knowt lists free practice modes for flashcards, while its plan page associates particular AI features with Ultra. The availability of free practice does not establish an unlimited free allowance for turning documents into questions.[Knowt documentation, checked 2026-11-27](https://knowt.com/learn-mode) .


Include a question the passage cannot answer. In the town map example, ask how many surveyors walked the route. An acceptable reviewer should leave that unknown unless another part of the source supplies it. If you catch the tool inventing a count, remove the question. Generating more choices around an unsupported answer makes it harder to notice where the invention began.


Check the route back to the original on the device you use after class. If finding a page reference means scrolling through a tiny fullscreen slide every time, save your verified questions with the section heading and the lecturer's figure title. A source you can relocate on a phone is more useful during a short break than a precise reference that only makes sense on a laptop.


## How do I handle a YouTube lecture link to practice questions Philippines search?


Start with a lecture you have permission to use and identify the exact passage you want to practise. A video link, a transcript and your own notes contain different evidence. A transcript may say “look at this side” without naming the diagram. Pause there, write the label in your own words and note the point in the lecture where it appears. Check the current input screen before assuming a service accepts that link.


When the teacher assigns a textbook illustration alongside the video, keep the book open for the visual question. The course outline tells you which illustration is assigned but gives little practice on its own. A self-made sketch with the labels covered can do more for a map-reading quiz than a polished audio summary. If the assignment is to explain an argument in words, a source notebook may be the better use of your preparation time.[Notebooklm documentation, checked 2026-11-27](https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16213268?hl=en) .


Before uploading, inspect the actual slides for class lists, names under screenshots or comments left during a group presentation. Educational information is sensitive under the Philippine education-sector advisory. Make a permitted excerpt without those details or type a fresh example yourself. Do the same with a video transcript that records questions from identifiable students.[Philippine education-sector advisory, checked 2026-11-27](https://www.privacy.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/DP-Council-Education-Sector-Advisory-No.-2020-1.pdf) .


Keep the file version with your corrected questions. When a lecturer replaces a deck, check the figures and captions you used before reusing last week's cards. A changed legend can alter the answer even if the slide title stayed exactly the same.
